xe3-discovery.dram_basis: Declared discovery input from firmware, not measured: X-E3 1.32 copy B (stream-035426a8) 0xd03ad8 sets the attribute of 0x1417000-0x3fffffff to 3, the same value 0xd03aa8 gives the read-write range 0xff2000-0x1417000 below the application stream base, so the firmware uses RAM up to 1 GiB. Addresses are from research/xpp-boot-memory-setup.md; copy A (stream-00230268) has different code in this range and must not be used to check them.
